topic: Japanese instance data transfer and shutdown
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical issues related to a newly launched Japanese instance. Initial attempts to synchronize data from the raw third-party directory (`/data/data/allunite/raw_data_3rd_party`) using `rsync` failed due to connection timeouts and unexplained errors when connecting to `clicknorris.allunite.local`. The participants discussed alternative methods, including simple copy commands and SSH access from the Japanese server. After troubleshooting connectivity issues (possibly related to port or routing), a successful data transfer was achieved using `aws s3 sync` to an S3 bucket.

The session concluded with a request to shut down the Japanese instance.
decisions: Data synchronization for the Japanese raw third-party directory was successfully completed using aws s3 sync.
